title: Right To Travel Simplified For Everyone -No License No Plates No Insurance No Problem
summary: Right-to-travel tutorial claiming private travellers need no licence or plates, are exempt from speed laws, win dismissal by grilling the officer, and can sue for damages.

assertions.quote: I don't need a driver's license or registration to exercise my right to travel
a motor vehicle by federal law is defined as something used for Commerce transporting goods or people for hire you're not doing that
speeding regulations apply to drivers of Motor Vehicles engaged in Commerce since I'm not driving commercially those laws don't apply to me

verdicts.note: Speed limits apply to every driver on public roads; courts reject the commercial-only reading.
The Maryland law upheld covered speed and rules of the road along with licensing for every motor vehicle operator, with no commercial limitation.

assertions.quote: I move for immediate dismissal of this case based on lack of jurisdiction

verdicts.note: Commerce is not an element of ordinary traffic offences; courts convict and call the argument frivolous.
The state argued the driver was not in commerce at all, and his conviction was affirmed; state motor vehicle rules reach all vehicles on its highways, so no commerce needs to be proved.

assertions.quote: you can file a lawsuit under 42 USC section 1983 for violations of your civil rights under color of law
